newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee dives in kerb, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee dives in kerb, seen mixed.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.65 down to 41.00 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday on rumours, which were denied by the central bank, that the government would freeze foreign currency deposit accounts.
The rupee is likely to open mixed on Tuesday because of the bank's denial of the rumour, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 10.50 percent, compared to the opening at 9.20 percent.
